title: Natura’s $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger | TechCrunch
summary: The smart ring was not the company’s first product. The company says the ring’s manufacturing costs are comparable to those of products like the Oura Ring and Samsung Galaxy Ring because they use many of the same components.
